name: SenseNova 6.8 Code2Video

lineage.base_model: not stated on the card (tags: qwen3.8; config is a 64-layer Qwen3.5-architecture model with hidden size 5120)

purpose: Lightweight open model for code-driven video creation: builds and renders short videos entirely as executable code, reviews frames and revises; long term a model that coordinates generative models and creative tools through code (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo.

architecture.kind: Qwen3.5-architecture dense vision-language model (64 layers, hidden 5120 per config)
architecture.why_this_design: card: code is the entry point to video because it connects image, video, 3D and editing tools; no architecture rationale

variants.notes: card serves it with tensor parallel 4 and 524,288 context via an override

pc-12gb.notes: 54.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 54.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 54.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 54.7 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 54.7 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 54.7 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 54.7 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: SGLang (qwen3 reasoning parser, qwen3_coder tool parser)
engine_support.notes: Card names Claude Code as the recommended harness (Anthropic-compatible endpoint, 512K context, 2,000+ turns, 10 h+ runs).

strengths: sustains runs of more than 10 hours and 2,000 turns in a coding-agent harness (vendor statement)
weaknesses: no benchmark numbers on the card; results described as preliminary

tona_fit.reason: A long-horizon agentic coder tuned for a niche (code-rendered video) at 55 GB BF16; interesting as evidence of 10-hour agent runs on a 27B-class dense model, but unquantified quality and no benchmarks.
